channel.title: Israel National News Flashes
channel.description: Latest news flashes from Israel National News

item.title: 'That crazy woman': Rabbi Yitzhak Yosef launches scathing attack on Baharav-Miara
item.description: Rabbi Yitzhak Yosef sharply criticizes the Attorney General over the controversy surrounding a memorial event for his father: “She is going after Maran, and this will not go unanswered."

item.title: Yotam Haim’s mother sends stunning message to soldier on trial
item.description: Iris Haim, whose son was accidentally killed in Gaza, says anger and revenge over the killing of an Israeli by IDF soldiers will only lead to more deaths.

item.title: Likud warns: ‘Ramallah wants Netanyahu to lose’
item.description: New report says Palestinian Authority officials pushed Arab parties to unite against Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, Likud hits back.

item.title: Five things Jews (and Christians) need to know about October 7 and its aftermath
item.description: Five things Jews (and Christians) need to know about October 7 and its aftermath

item.title: Anti-Israel activist suspected of sexually assaulting child
item.description: Anti-Israel activist targeted one of three children near the Barkai neighborhood; residents detained the suspect until police arrived, Har Hevron Council says.

item.title: COGAT reveals: Between 20-30% of Gaza aid isn't food
item.description: Hundreds of trucks carrying food, medical supplies and water infrastructure equipment entered Gaza through Israel, while 150 residents departed for third countries, official data reveals.

item.title: 76-year-old attacked over noise complaint
item.description: What started with a polite request to lower the volume allegedly ended with a violent assault, a police investigation, and a shaken guesthouse owner questioning whether he should have called police sooner.

item.title: New details emerge: Debts, secrecy and what Mali Yahalomi left behind
item.description: More than NIS 200,000 in debt, a surprise 50th birthday party and an apartment left untouched: New details reveal what preceded Mali and Liel Yahalomi’s mysterious departure.

item.title: August goes wild: Thunderstorms, lightning and 70 km/h winds hit Israel
item.description: Rare late-August weather system brings strong winds and haze, with heavy rain and localized flooding possible in northern Israel.

item.title: Shin Bet confirms Iranian plot to target Yair Netanyahu
item.description: Intelligence on a concrete threat prompted the urgent evacuation of the Prime Minister’s son from Florida to Israel under heavy security.

item.title: Ben Gvir blasts Netanyahu over ‘cynical’ unity talks
item.description: Itamar Ben Gvir accuses Netanyahu and Smotrich of using a staged unity push to pressure Moshe Feiglin into lowering his demands for an electoral bloc.

item.title: Former hostage: 'In Hamas tunnels I surrendered to G-d and found light in the darkness'
item.description: In an emotional interview, Omer Shem Tov, speaks of the guilt he still feels, his friendship with Uri Danino, the moment he surrendered himself to G-d deep inside the tunnel, and the dream he has embraced since returning home: to win an Oscar.

item.title: Haredim block Jerusalem entrance over Shabbat buses
item.description: At least 13 buses from northern Israel stopped as protesters block entrance to Jerusalem over public transportation operating on the Sabbath.

item.title: Violent clashes in Qusra
item.description: Clashes erupt in Qusra, Jalud, after Israelis begin to hit back following rock attack by local Arabs.

item.title: IDF strikes Hamas commander hiding in Gaza hospital
item.description: Hamas commander planning attacks against troops and Israeli civilians, working to rebuild Hamas capabilities in violation of ceasefire, is eliminated while hiding in hospital.

item.title: IDF eliminates Hamas Nukhba commander, sniper in Gaza
item.description: Two Hamas terrorists advancing attacks against troops and Israeli civilians, working to rebuild Hamas capabilities in violation of the ceasefire, are eliminated in Gaza.

item.title: Shabbat Shalom!
item.description:
Arutz Sheva-Israel National News is stopping its round-the-clock news updates at this time in honor of the start of Shabbat in North America, where they are being written now.
Updates will resume Saturday night from Israel, following the conclusion of Shabbat at 19:44 Jerusalem time.
Shabbat Shalom!

item.description:
The Justice Department is appealing the dismissal of its antisemitism lawsuit against Harvard, seeking to revive a case involving nearly $1 billion.
(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

item.title: Shabbat Shalom from Israel!
item.description:
Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' Israel desk is stopping its round-the-clock news updates at this time in honor of Shabbat. Jerusalem candle lighting time is 18:28 on Friday. Our North American desk will keep you informed until the 19:16 EDT candle lighting time in New York.
The updates from Israel will resume Saturday night, following the conclusion of Shabbat at 19:44 in Jerusalem.
Shabbat Shalom!

item.title: Haredi soldiers to be integrated into intelligence roles in Brigade 146
item.description: As part of the "Headstart Intelligence" project, haredi soldiers will undergo professional training, acquire a civilian profession, and will operate in a facility adapted to their way of life.

item.title: 7-year-old boy drowns at park in south Tel Aviv
item.description:
The death of a seven-year-old boy who drowned in a lake at a park in south Tel Aviv has been confirmed.
The boy was located earlier in very serious condition after rescue forces conducted searches for him at the site and performed CPR on him.

item.title: IDF eliminates head of a terrorist cell in Jenin in an airstrike
item.description:
The IDF carried out a targeted airstrike a short time ago against several terrorists in Jenin, in the Menashe Regional Brigade area.
A security official said that three terrorists were inside the targeted vehicle.
The main target of the strike was a terrorist identified as the head of a terror network in Jenin, along with two additional accomplices who were working to advance terrorist attacks.

item.title: Trump sends message with AI-generated image
item.description:
US President Donald Trump published an AI-generated image showing him holding a rifle with explosions in the background, and wrote: “No more Mr. Nice Guy."
The post came amid the threats he directed at Iran at the time, after calling on Tehran to “come to its senses quickly" and reach an agreement on the nuclear issue.
גגכצילום: ההה
